== Notes ==
* The range for this skill is much shorter than the resurrection range of [[Comfort Animal]] and one must practically stand on the dead pet for it or others to revive making it unwieldy in battle.
* As of the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20090806|August 6, 2009]] game update, [[Comfort Animal]] can be used instead of Charm Animal for your companion to travel with you in [[PvE]] areas. [[Heal as One]] was later updated with the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20100225|February 25, 2010]] game update to also have this functionality. These updates largely render Revive Animal suboptimal because of their ability to resurrect pets, mandatory bar placement for pet usage, cast time, recharge time, pet heal and range.
